# Wharf 0.11.0 plan

1. Add typed attempts, lifecycle states, scheduler limits, counts, and events.
2. Implement stable ordering, bounded work-conserving admission, and trial
   limits.
3. Bank successful logical attempts and skip duplicates.
4. Emit preparing, starting, agent, completed, errored, and cancelled state.
5. Add deterministic ordering, concurrency, limit, failure, banking, and
   cancellation tests.
6. Update repository memory and closeout records, then run formatting, build,
   tests, and diff checks.
